doc: The rerun target's scope sidecar (I50b, spec/M4/lib/heldout_rerun.json target.scope_sidecar): the sealed scope sidecar (targets/scroll/extract_solidity.json) at sidecar_version 2, which adds rule D1 to the frontend's coverage walk (a branch no reach of its if statement selects is dead_code debt), with its own output. It names what to extract, never what the extraction says. Labelled: contaminated (post-seal change).

target.scope: transitions of every external/public function, storage families, cost terms, principal predicates, hash/commit edges, coverage
